description:
The Huffy Mod X 12-inch bike is designed for kids ages 3–5 who are typically between 37 and 42 inches tall. Its kid-friendly sizing and sturdy steel frame help young riders feel steady, confident, and excited to ride.
Removable training wheels give beginners the support they need while learning, then come off easily as skills improve. A front hand brake and rear coaster brake help kids practice safe, controlled stopping as confidence builds.
A padded saddle and easy-to-hold grips are designed for small hands and short rides that turn into big milestones. Smooth-rolling tires help every ride feel steady and comfortable.
With a racing red frame, bold graphics, and sporty design, the Mod X brings excitement to every ride. It’s a bike kids are proud to show off and parents feel confident choosing.

components.description: Dual Braking System: A front hand brake plus rear coaster brake help kids learn confident, controlled stopping.
